# LodePNG

The PNG decoder is vendored from [LodePNG](https://github.com/lvandeve/lodepng/tree/7b2893e35891c0c85bee5595caafaf3c2044b409) at commit `7b2893e35891c0c85bee5595caafaf3c2044b409`. Upstream files are unmodified. The build uses the in-memory PNG decoder and disables encoding, direct file access, and ancillary metadata parsing. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
